newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bacob in 5 bln Bfr mortgage-backed security issue.
newsitem.headline: Bacob in 5 bln Bfr mortgage-backed security issue.

text.p: Belgian Bacob Bank said it had launched a mortgage-backed security issue on Thursday for 5.215 billion Belgian francs, and the issue had closed early after selling out.
It had been due to close on June 19.
The issue was launched in two tranches - one billion francs of 4.29 percent notes maturing in September 2003, and 4.215 billion francs of 6.37 percent notes maturing in June 2017.
The issuer is Atrium-2 N.V, and shareholders of the issuer include the Flemish regional investment company GIMV.
The notes will be issued as permanent global notes with a minimum denomination of five million francs, and will be listed in Belgium.
